content.text:
The robot followed the corridor to the end and stopped in front of the green panel, about 0.5–0.6 m away by sonar. I then called rest, and it is now crouched with the motors off.

The corridor ran straight for about 3 m, then turned left. The walls on the left and the turn set off collision protection several times. I fixed that by sidestepping right and re-aiming, with no falls or bumps. After the turn the panel was another 3 m ahead.
